verdict.rationale: Sill's GitHub README documents an opt-in virtual display on the Mac host. It moves a streamed window onto its own display so the window keeps updating when other windows cover it, which delivers the core of the story. Nothing in the evidence covers headless operation, so only the covered-window half is shown. missing for 10: evidence that streaming keeps rendering on a headless Mac, independent or hands-on corroboration, deeper first-party documentation of the virtual display.

support.subject: As a power user, the host can create a virtual display, so a streamed window keeps rendering when covered or the machine runs headless

citations.quote: The virtual display (off by default) moves a window you stream onto a display of its own on your Mac, so it keeps updating when other windows cover it.
